title: Where We Stand on the Pandemic

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Donald G.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事唐纳德·G·

sentences.en: McNeil Jr., on four new developments in the treatment and understanding of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 麦克尼尔将介绍新冠病毒治疗和认知方面的四项新进展。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, August 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月25日，星期二。

sentences.en: Donald, we wanted to check back in with you because the summer is drawing to a close,
sentences.zh: 唐纳德，我们想找你跟进一下，因为夏天即将结束，

sentences.en: and there have been a few major developments in the pandemic that we wanted to better understand by talking to you, our resident expert on the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 疫情出现了一些重大进展，我们想通过采访你这位我们的新冠病毒常驻专家来更好地了解这些情况。

sentences.en: And the first development involves a new treatment in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 第一个进展涉及美国的一项新疗法。

sentences.en: So tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲吧。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: It's good to see you all.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到大家。

sentences.en: So just in time for the Republican Convention,
sentences.zh: 就在共和党全国代表大会召开之际，

sentences.en: the Food and Drug Administration director on the podium with his boss, the head of HHS, and his boss, the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 食品药品监督管理局局长与他的上司——卫生与公众服务部部长，以及他的上司——美国总统一起站在了讲台上。

sentences.en: Today, I'm pleased to make a truly historic announcement in our battle against the China virus that will save countless lives.
sentences.zh: 今天，我很高兴在抗击“中国病毒”的战斗中宣布一项真正具有历史意义的决定，这将挽救无数生命。

sentences.en: Gave emergency use authorization.
sentences.zh: 给予了紧急使用授权。

sentences.en: A powerful term, emergency use authorization for a treatment known as convalescent plasma.
sentences.zh: 这是一个强有力的词汇，即针对一种被称为恢复期血浆的疗法的紧急使用授权。

sentences.en: To a therapy called convalescent plasma.
sentences.zh: 针对一种叫做恢复期血浆的疗法。

sentences.en: Because the FDA really stepped up, and especially over the last few days in getting this done,
sentences.zh: 因为FDA确实加大了力度，特别是在过去几天里完成了这项工作，

sentences.en: and the results have been incredible, and I think you'll see the results even go up very substantially.
sentences.zh: 结果令人难以置信，我认为你们会看到效果有非常显著的提升。

sentences.en: So we appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们对此表示感谢。

sentences.en: And Donald, what is convalescent plasma?
sentences.zh: 唐纳德，什么是恢复期血浆？

sentences.en: Convalescent plasma is the serum from blood that's taken from people who are convalescing, who are recovering from having had COVID.
sentences.zh: 恢复期血浆是指从那些正在康复中、即从新冠肺炎中恢复过来的人的血液中提取的血清。

sentences.en: You draw out about a pint of their blood, you spin it down to take off the red blood cells and white blood cells,
sentences.zh: 你抽出大约一品脱他们的血液，通过离心分离去除红细胞和白细胞，

sentences.en: and then you keep the serum that contains a lot of things, including the antibodies.
sentences.zh: 然后保留含有许多成分（包括抗体）的血清。

sentences.en: I probably shouldn't admit this, but I used to sell plasma when I was in college.
sentences.zh: 我可能不该承认这一点，但我在大学时曾卖过血浆。

sentences.en: Wait, I'm sorry, whose plasma did you sell?
sentences.zh: 等等，抱歉，你卖的是谁的血浆？

sentences.en: Mine.
sentences.zh: 我自己的。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: Yeah, $5 for the first donation a week, $15 for the second.
sentences.zh: 是的，第一次捐献5美元，第二次15美元。

sentences.en: I paid my rent for part of the time in college that way.
sentences.zh: 我在大学期间有一部分房租就是这么付的。

sentences.en: And I assume, although I never asked back then, that they wanted it for the clotting factors, for hemophilia, actually.
sentences.zh: 我猜，虽然我当时没问，但他们要它是为了凝血因子，实际上是用于治疗血友病。

sentences.en: And just to be clear, who were you selling it to?
sentences.zh: 明确一下，你当时是卖给谁的？

sentences.en: Presumably not, like, somebody off the street.
sentences.zh: 大概不是卖给路人吧。

sentences.en: No, no, to a blood bank.
sentences.zh: 不，不，是卖给血库。

sentences.en: And why would anyone pay for your plasma or anyone else's plasma, for that matter?
sentences.zh: 为什么会有人花钱买你的血浆，或者任何人的血浆呢？

sentences.en: What is so special about blood plasma?
sentences.zh: 血浆到底有什么特别之处？

sentences.en: It contains your antibodies, and antibodies is what they need to kill the virus as it's going through them.
sentences.zh: 它含有你的抗体，而抗体正是他们消灭病毒所需要的。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And so this is now being applied to COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 所以现在这被应用到了新冠肺炎（COVID-19）上。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: People who have had COVID and are immune to it are in very high demand for their plasma, which has antibodies in it,
sentences.zh: 那些患过新冠肺炎并产生免疫力的人，他们的血浆需求量很大，因为里面含有抗体，

sentences.en: which is what the president and the FDA approved for emergency youth authorization this weekend.
sentences.zh: 这就是总统和FDA在本周末批准紧急使用授权的东西。

sentences.en: And today I once again urge all Americans who have recovered from the virus to go to coronavirus.gov and sign up and donate plasma today, please.
sentences.zh: 今天，我再次敦促所有已康复的美国人前往coronavirus.gov网站注册并捐献血浆，拜托了。

sentences.en: And what was the evidence that the Trump administration cited in granting this emergency youth authorization for blood plasma?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府在授予血浆紧急使用授权时引用了什么证据？

sentences.en: There is a program to distribute plasma and analyze the results run by the Mayo Clinic, and they are aiming to give the plasma out to 70,000 patients and see how they do.
sentences.zh: 有一个由梅奥诊所运营的血浆分发和结果分析项目，他们的目标是为7万名患者提供血浆，并观察效果。

sentences.en: And the result was that people who got plasma did not do better across the board.
sentences.zh: 结果显示，接受血浆治疗的人并没有全面好转。

sentences.en: But if you splice out a subgroup of people who were under 80 years old, hospitalized but not on ventilators, were given a high dose of plasma, not a low or medium dose,
sentences.zh: 但如果你剔除出一个亚组，即80岁以下、住院但未上呼吸机、接受了高剂量（而非低剂量或中剂量）血浆，

sentences.en: and were given it within three days of diagnosis, those people did better.
sentences.zh: 并且在确诊后三天内接受治疗的患者，这些人情况更好。

sentences.en: And better was defined as – they seemed to have a 35 percent lower chance of dying.
sentences.zh: 所谓“更好”的定义是——他们的死亡率似乎降低了35%。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So a narrow slice of that overall group of people who got this blood plasma did 35 percent better, and that was the basis for this emergency authorization.
sentences.zh: 所以，在接受血浆治疗的总体人群中，只有一小部分人的情况改善了35%，这就是紧急授权的基础。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But some doctors, some experts, are unhappy with the way this is done because they would want to know a lot more things.
sentences.zh: 但一些医生和专家对这种做法感到不满，因为他们想了解更多信息。

sentences.en: Even in the context of this trial,
sentences.zh: 即使是在这项试验的背景下，

sentences.en: they would like to know what other treatments those patients got just in case they got something like the steroids that we already know save people or the remdesivir that we already know saves people.
sentences.zh: 他们也想知道这些患者还接受了什么其他治疗，以防他们使用了我们已知能救命的类固醇，或者我们已知有效的瑞德西韦。

sentences.en: And really what they'd like to see is a real randomized clinical trial done in which half the people got plasma and the other half of the people got placebo,
sentences.zh: 他们真正想看到的是一项真正的随机临床试验，其中一半人接受血浆，另一半人接受安慰剂，

sentences.en: and neither the doctors nor the patients knew who was getting which.
sentences.zh: 而且医生和患者都不知道谁接受了哪种治疗。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because that's really the only way in order to prove something really works.
sentences.zh: 因为这是证明某样东西真正有效的唯一方法。

sentences.en: So why not undertake such a clinical trial now?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么现在不进行这样的临床试验呢？

sentences.en: The Tony Fauci's and Francis Collins would love to.
sentences.zh: 托尼·福奇和弗朗西斯·柯林斯很想这样做。

sentences.en: The problem is that people are so excited about the idea of plasma because it's been talked up that they refuse to go into a clinical trial because they would get a 50 percent chance of getting the placebo.
sentences.zh: 问题是人们对血浆疗法太兴奋了，因为宣传得太多，他们拒绝参加临床试验，因为那样有50%的概率会分到安慰剂。

sentences.en: And once you're sick, you don't want that.
sentences.zh: 一旦生病了，你就不想那样。

sentences.en: You want, hey, if you think it saves me, give it to me.
sentences.zh: 你会想，嘿，如果你觉得它能救我，那就给我用吧。

sentences.en: Oh, that's interesting.
sentences.zh: 噢，那很有趣。

sentences.en: So the government's decision, the Trump administration's decision, to talk up blood plasma as a potential treatment, even though there's not a ton of evidence for it,
sentences.zh: 所以，特朗普政府决定大力宣传血浆作为一种潜在疗法，尽管并没有大量证据支持，

sentences.en: might actually make it harder to do the kind of gold standard clinical trial test that lots of doctors, it sounds like including Anthony Fauci,
sentences.zh: 这实际上可能让那种医生们（听起来包括安东尼·福奇）想要的“黄金标准”临床试验变得更难进行，

sentences.en: would want to know whether or not plasma really is a serious therapy for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道血浆是否真的是一种针对新冠肺炎的有效疗法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's exactly what happened with hydroxychloroquine.
sentences.zh: 这和羟氯喹的情况完全一样。

sentences.en: It was talked up so much that people wanted it.
sentences.zh: 它被吹捧得太厉害了，以至于人们都想要它。

sentences.en: And so it became hard to do the clinical trials in which they got a 50 percent chance of getting a placebo because they didn't want it.
sentences.zh: 因此，很难进行那种有50%概率获得安慰剂的临床试验，因为人们不想要安慰剂。

sentences.en: They heard the president say it's a miracle drug, so they insisted on it.
sentences.zh: 他们听到总统说是“神药”，所以他们坚持要用。

sentences.en: And, of course, in the case of hydroxychloroquine, that, too, was granted an emergency authorization from the Trump administration as a treatment.
sentences.zh: 当然，在羟氯喹的案例中，它也获得了特朗普政府的紧急授权作为治疗手段。

sentences.en: But then subsequent testing showed it was not considered effective and it was not considered so safe and that emergency authorization was eventually rescinded.
sentences.zh: 但随后的测试表明它被认为无效，也不够安全，该紧急授权最终被撤销了。

sentences.en: It was not considered effective at all and it was definitely dangerous.
sentences.zh: 它被认为根本无效，而且绝对是危险的。

sentences.en: And so emergency authorization was rescinded.
sentences.zh: 所以紧急授权被撤销了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So this potentially could be a similar situation.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是一个类似的情况。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In fact, the doctor said that to me yesterday.
sentences.zh: 事实上，昨天就有医生对我这么说。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This feels like hydroxychloroquine all over again.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像羟氯喹事件重演。

sentences.en: I mean, the president is hoping to be able to announce a miracle.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，总统希望能宣布一个奇迹。

sentences.en: And that's the tone.
sentences.zh: 这就是基调。

sentences.en: The calls to the press conference on Sunday were, you know, gigantic therapeutic breakthrough going to come through this evening.
sentences.zh: 周日新闻发布会的预告是，你知道，今晚将会有巨大的治疗突破。

sentences.en: And then everybody was saying, I think he's going to talk about convalescent plasma, which we've known about since the 1890s.
sentences.zh: 然后每个人都在说，我想他要谈的是恢复期血浆，我们从1890年代就知道这个了。

sentences.en: And what this really is,
sentences.zh: 而这实际上是，

sentences.en: is it's a bureaucratic breakthrough because hospitals are going to find it easier to use plasma than they did before because they don't have to go to the Mayo Clinic for permission to enroll in the trial.
sentences.zh: 这是一个官僚层面的突破，因为医院会发现使用血浆比以前更容易了，因为他们不必去梅奥诊所申请参加试验的许可。

sentences.en: But that's all.
sentences.zh: 但仅此而已。

sentences.en: And what Tony Fauci and Francis Collins and Clifford Lane and the others at the NIH said just in the last week or so,
sentences.zh: 而托尼·福奇、弗朗西斯·柯林斯、克利福德·莱恩以及NIH的其他人在过去一周左右所说的是，

sentences.en: we don't think an emergency use authorization should be granted.
sentences.zh: 我们认为不应该授予紧急使用授权。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And the president basically just reversed them.
sentences.zh: 而总统基本上只是推翻了他们的意见。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Or overruled them.
sentences.zh: 或者说否决了他们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Donald, the second big recent development in the pandemic involves a case of reinfection out of Asia.
sentences.zh: 那么，唐纳德，疫情最近的第二个重大进展涉及亚洲的一例再感染病例。

sentences.en: Tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲那个。

sentences.en: Researchers in China say a 33-year-old man living in Hong Kong is the first person confirmed to have been reinfected with the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 中国的研究人员称，一名居住在香港的33岁男子是首例被证实再次感染新冠病毒的人。

sentences.en: So, the case is about a man who gets infected in Hong Kong early in the year, recovers, four and a half months later, goes to Spain, gets sick again, recovers.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个病例是一名男子在年初于香港感染，康复后，四个月后去了西班牙，再次生病，然后康复。

sentences.en: And so, doctors know that he got infected twice.
sentences.zh: 医生们知道他感染了两次。

sentences.en: Which is kind of the nightmare situation.
sentences.zh: 这简直是噩梦般的情况。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, this is a potentially serious setback tonight in our war against coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这在今晚确实是我们抗击新冠病毒战争中的一个潜在严重挫折。

sentences.en: This new case you mentioned out of Hong Kong really does put into question that belief that so many of us have had that if you got coronavirus once, you couldn't get it again.
sentences.zh: 你提到的这个香港新病例确实让人质疑我们许多人一直以来的信念，即如果你得过一次新冠病毒，就不会再得第二次。

sentences.en: The reason that would worry people is because, well, that would imply that we're never free of the disease and maybe a vaccine wouldn't work.
sentences.zh: 人们担心的原因是，这暗示我们永远无法摆脱这种疾病，也许疫苗也不会起作用。

sentences.en: Because if you got a vaccine, you were protected.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你接种了疫苗，你就受到了保护。

sentences.en: And then, you know, a couple months later you got infected again, then, you know, the vaccine's a buSt.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，几个月后你又被感染了，那么，你知道，疫苗就白打了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Infection is supposed to equal immunity.
sentences.zh: 感染应该等于免疫。

sentences.en: Infection is supposed to produce immunity.
sentences.zh: 感染应该产生免疫力。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now, in this case that was just reported out of Hong Kong, this doesn't shock immunologists.
sentences.zh: 现在，在刚刚从香港报道的这个病例中，这并没有让免疫学家感到震惊。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Well, because it's been known that even with some diseases where you think getting it provides lifetime immunity, some people get it again.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为众所周知，即使对于某些你认为得过一次就能终身免疫的疾病，有些人还是会再次感染。

sentences.en: And what happened in this guy's case was his first bout of the disease was mild, and his second bout was so mild it was asymptomatic.
sentences.zh: 在这个人的案例中，他第一次患病时症状轻微，第二次患病时症状轻微到无症状。

sentences.en: He didn't realize he had it.
sentences.zh: 他自己都没意识到感染了。

sentences.en: And what may have happened in this case is that he had such a mild infection the first time that he got over it,
sentences.zh: 这个病例中可能发生的情况是，他第一次感染时症状太轻，以至于他挺过来了，

sentences.en: but he really didn't produce enough long-lasting immunity in the form of antibodies to prevent him from getting a second infection.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有产生足够的、以抗体形式存在的持久免疫力来防止他再次感染。

sentences.en: So, the reaction of doctors is, well, this is a curiosity, and it's kind of the exception that proves the rule, but it's not something to panic about.
sentences.zh: 所以医生的反应是，好吧，这只是个奇闻，算是证明规则的例外，但不是什么值得恐慌的事情。

sentences.en: This is not common.
sentences.zh: 这并不常见。

sentences.en: This is not something we're seeing all over the place.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们随处可见的情况。

sentences.en: Millions and millions and millions of infections around the world, and we've only seen one proven case.
sentences.zh: 全世界有数以亿计的感染病例，我们只看到了这一例确诊病例。

sentences.en: So, don't worry that this means the end of the vaccine or the vaccine won't work or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 所以，不要担心这意味着疫苗的终结，或者疫苗不起作用之类的。

sentences.en: So, this does not fundamentally change our understanding of immunity from a COVID-19 infection.
sentences.zh: 所以，这并没有从根本上改变我们对新冠肺炎感染后免疫力的理解。

sentences.en: We're still in the gray area where we don't know how long immunity lasts, but we suspect it lasts for a year or more,
sentences.zh: 我们仍然处于灰色地带，不知道免疫力能持续多久，但我们怀疑它能持续一年或更久，

sentences.en: although that's impossible to prove because this disease is only – it didn't come into existence before December.
sentences.zh: 尽管这无法证明，因为这种疾病才——它在12月之前根本不存在。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But looking at other diseases like it, that's what the best immunologists expect to happen.
sentences.zh: 但参考其他类似疾病，这就是最好的免疫学家所预期的结果。

sentences.en: Donald, immunity for a year or so would probably imply that whenever a vaccine is ready, it might last just a year, or is that too big a logical leap?
sentences.zh: 唐纳德，免疫力持续一年左右可能意味着无论疫苗何时准备好，它可能只能持续一年，还是说这个逻辑跳跃太大了？

sentences.en: So, the answer is nobody knows yet because we don't have the vaccine and we don't have a year's experience with the virus.
sentences.zh: 答案是没人知道，因为我们还没有疫苗，也没有对这种病毒一年的研究经验。

sentences.en: But we know that some viruses mutate so fast that you need a vaccine every year, typically the flu virus.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道有些病毒变异很快，你需要每年接种疫苗，通常是流感病毒。

sentences.en: We know that this virus mutates at about one-third the rate of flu.
sentences.zh: 我们知道这种病毒的变异速度大约是流感的三分之一。

sentences.en: So, maybe if it, you know, hangs around, we'll need a new shot every three years rather than every year as you do with flu.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果它一直存在，我们可能每三年需要打一针，而不是像流感那样每年都要打。

sentences.en: But this is all a big gray area.
sentences.zh: 但这都是一个巨大的灰色地带。

sentences.en: It's really hard to say.
sentences.zh: 真的很难说。

sentences.en: No expert is going to say we know what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 没有专家会说我们知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，你愿意吗？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在机会来了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，即可免费畅享首月内容。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》的订阅者每天都能读到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《纽约时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Chinese military is actually giving doses of the vaccine developed by a unit of the China National Pharmaceutical Group to soldiers and employees traveling overseas.
sentences.zh: 中国军方实际上正在为前往海外的士兵和员工接种由中国医药集团下属单位研发的疫苗。

sentences.en: That still, though, is in the phase three testing.
sentences.zh: 但那仍然处于三期临床试验阶段。

sentences.en: It's experimental.
sentences.zh: 它还处于实验性阶段。

sentences.en: Russia is claiming victory in the worldwide race for a coronavirus vaccine.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯声称在新冠疫苗的全球竞赛中获胜。

sentences.en: The government is clearing a vaccine for use despite not putting it through a third round of testing on humans.
sentences.zh: 尽管尚未进行第三轮人体测试，但政府已批准该疫苗的使用。

sentences.en: President Vladimir Putin insists the vaccine is safe and says one of his daughters has been inoculated.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京总统坚称该疫苗是安全的，并表示他的一个女儿已经接种了。

sentences.en: Donald, our third development relates to the progress that we are making in the battle for a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德，我们的第三个进展与我们在疫苗研发之战中取得的进展有关。

sentences.en: And the biggest of these developments seem to be occurring overseas in Russia and in China.
sentences.zh: 而这些进展中最大的似乎发生在海外，即俄罗斯和中国。

sentences.en: And I was hoping you could update us on those.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能为我们更新一下相关情况。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Both the Russians and just recently the Chinese say they have started distributing their vaccines without having done the phase three safety and efficacy trials that we are doing here.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人和最近的中国人都在说，他们已经开始分发疫苗，而没有进行我们这里正在进行的第三期安全性和有效性试验。

sentences.en: And those are the ones that are double blind with the placebo like we talked about before.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们之前谈到的那种双盲安慰剂对照试验。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And more importantly, they recruit tens of thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，他们招募了数万人。

sentences.en: I think for these trials we're recruiting 30,000 people per vaccine.
sentences.zh: 我想我们这些试验每种疫苗招募了3万人。

sentences.en: So immunologists and vaccine executives here say this is crazy what the Russians and the Chinese are doing.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的免疫学家和疫苗高管们说，俄罗斯人和中国人的做法简直是疯了。

sentences.en: You don't release a vaccine before you've done the big safety trial because problems that you did not find earlier could crop up.
sentences.zh: 在完成大型安全试验之前，你不能发布疫苗，因为之前没有发现的问题可能会突然出现。

sentences.en: And the big dangerous problem, the one that everybody is worried about, is that the vaccine makes you more likely to have a bad outcome if you do have the virus,
sentences.zh: 而每个人都担心的一个重大危险问题是，如果你真的感染了病毒，疫苗反而会让你更有可能出现不良后果，

sentences.en: as in more likely to get hospitalized and die.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，更有可能住院甚至死亡。

sentences.en: So doctors here think that Russians and the Chinese are very responsible to do this.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的医生认为俄罗斯人和中国人的做法非常不负责任。

sentences.en: It looks like they may be doing it for competitive reasons.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们这样做可能是出于竞争原因。

sentences.en: The Russians want to – they call their vaccine Sputnik.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人想——他们把自己的疫苗称为“卫星”。

sentences.en: They want to brag that, hey, we beat the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们想吹嘘说，嘿，我们打败了美国。

sentences.en: We beat the world at this, you know, as they did with Sputnik back in 1957 or whatever it was for satellite in space.
sentences.zh: 我们在这一点上打败了世界，你知道，就像他们在1957年或无论哪一年在太空卫星上所做的那样。

sentences.en: So what they're really doing is using their own population as the guinea pigs for doing the safety and efficacy testing on the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 所以他们真正做的是把本国人口当作小白鼠，来对疫苗进行安全性和有效性测试。

sentences.en: And one hopes that, you know, they are following those first 30,000 guinea pigs really carefully to see if they pick up any danger signals that are there.
sentences.zh: 人们希望，你知道，他们能非常仔细地跟踪那最初的3万只“小白鼠”，看看是否能发现任何危险信号。

sentences.en: You want to make sure that the vaccines go to people you think are likely to do well, you know, healthy young people.
sentences.zh: 你要确保疫苗是给那些你认为身体状况良好的人接种的，你知道，健康的年轻人。

sentences.en: And then you move it out into the risk groups.
sentences.zh: 然后再将其推广到高风险群体。

sentences.en: But, Donald, and maybe I'm being unnecessarily provocative here,
sentences.zh: 但是，唐纳德，也许我这么说有点挑衅意味，

sentences.en: but how different is what China and Russia are doing with these vaccines from what the United States and our FDA is doing with hydroxychloroquine and blood plasma,
sentences.zh: 但中国和俄罗斯在这些疫苗上的做法，与美国和我们的FDA在羟氯喹和血浆方面的做法有什么不同呢？

sentences.en: which is starting to authorize the delivery of it to people before it's gone through those kind of gold standard double blind placebo tests?
sentences.zh: 在没有经过那种黄金标准的双盲安慰剂测试之前，就开始授权向人们提供这些药物？

sentences.en: It's similar, and yet it's different.
sentences.zh: 相似，但又不同。

sentences.en: It's similar because we are letting it be generally distributed before it's been proven that it works and is totally safe.
sentences.zh: 相似之处在于，我们都在证明其有效且绝对安全之前，就让它进行了普遍分发。

sentences.en: It's different because hydroxychloroquine did have a long safety record.
sentences.zh: 不同之处在于，羟氯喹确实有长期的安全记录。

sentences.en: Convulsant plasma does have a long safety record.
sentences.zh: 恢复期血浆确实有长期的安全记录。

sentences.en: These vaccines that the Chinese and the Russians are using have no safety record other than the tests they've done just in the last two or three months,
sentences.zh: 中国人和俄罗斯人使用的这些疫苗除了过去两三个月里所做的测试外，没有任何安全记录，

sentences.en: presumably on, you know, maybe 1,000 people.
sentences.zh: 大概是在，你知道，也许1000人身上做的测试。

sentences.en: Another important difference between what the Russians and Chinese are doing with their vaccines and what we're doing with treatments here is that treatments are given to people who are already sick and in trouble.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人和中国人在疫苗上的做法与我们在这里的治疗方法之间的另一个重要区别是，治疗方法是给予那些已经生病且处境困难的人。

sentences.en: Like, you can take wild chances with cancer treatments when you have patients who are on the brink of death and there's nothing else that will save them.
sentences.zh: 比如，当你的病人处于死亡边缘且没有其他办法挽救他们时，你可以冒极大的风险使用癌症治疗方法。

sentences.en: Whereas vaccines are given to healthy people, even sometimes to babies and pregnant women.
sentences.zh: 而疫苗是给健康人接种的，有时甚至是给婴儿和孕妇接种的。

sentences.en: So you do not want something that is at all unsafe because you turn someone from healthy into unhealthy.
sentences.zh: 所以你绝对不希望任何不安全的东西，因为这会把一个健康的人变成不健康的人。

sentences.en: You've done more damage than if you just left them alone.
sentences.zh: 你造成的损害比你什么都不做还要大。

sentences.en: So our risky emergency authorizations are less risky than what China and Russia are doing with vaccines because our emergency authorizations are going into sick people.
sentences.zh: 所以我们冒险的紧急授权比中国和俄罗斯在疫苗上的做法风险更小，因为我们的紧急授权是针对病人的。

sentences.en: Theirs are going into healthy people.
sentences.zh: 而他们的是针对健康人的。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: Okay, so Donald, finally, the fourth development here in the United States is a somewhat happy one for a change.
sentences.zh: 好的，唐纳德，最后，在美国的第四个进展总算是一个令人高兴的消息。

sentences.en: And that centers around the current infection rate in the United States, which is flattening.
sentences.zh: 那就是美国的当前感染率正在趋于平缓。

sentences.en: Yes, it's flattening, but I don't see this as a happy story.
sentences.zh: 是的，它在趋于平缓，但我并不认为这是一个令人高兴的故事。

sentences.en: What are we flattening at?
sentences.zh: 我们是在什么水平上趋于平缓的？

sentences.en: About 40,000 cases a day?
sentences.zh: 每天约4万例病例？

sentences.en: You know, even in our good period, back in June, we thought we were doing well.
sentences.zh: 你知道，即使在我们情况良好的时期，也就是6月份，我们还以为自己做得不错。

sentences.en: We had 20,000 new cases a day.
sentences.zh: 当时我们每天有2万例新病例。

sentences.en: None of this has been really a good news story.
sentences.zh: 这根本算不上什么好消息。

sentences.en: We have an out-of-control epidemic in this country.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的疫情已经失控了。

sentences.en: And the fact that we brought it down by 10,000 cases is good-ish news, you know, relative to how bad it was getting.
sentences.zh: 我们减少了1万例病例的事实算是一个好消息，你知道，相对于之前糟糕的情况而言。

sentences.en: But I don't think we should pat ourselves on our national back over 40,000 cases a day.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们不应该因为每天4万例病例就沾沾自喜。

sentences.en: And what are the implications of us even staying at such an infection rate?
sentences.zh: 那么，即使保持这样的感染率，又意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: The implications are that a lot of people are going to continue to die.
sentences.zh: 这意味着很多人将继续死亡。

sentences.en: You know, this is like climbing a mountain, and you get up to 14,000 feet, and you stay at 14,000 feet because you're walking through a meadow.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就像爬山，你爬到了14000英尺，然后停在那里，因为你在穿过一片草地。

sentences.en: It's still hard to breathe up at that altitude.
sentences.zh: 在那个高度呼吸仍然很困难。

sentences.en: It's not a happy situation.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个令人高兴的情况。

sentences.en: We're not going back down to zero.
sentences.zh: 我们不会回到零。

sentences.en: We're going back down to a few hundred cases a day, which some other countries have gone to.
sentences.zh: 我们不会回到每天几百例的水平，而其他一些国家已经做到了。

sentences.en: The implication is that we're going to have more people hospitalized, more people die.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们将有更多的人住院，更多的人死亡。

sentences.en: We're going to see our death numbers go up beyond 200,000, definitely on the way to 300,000.
sentences.zh: 我们将看到我们的死亡人数超过20万，并且肯定正在迈向30万。

sentences.en: Don't know exactly when it's going to reach that, but we're steadily plotting day after day up that peak of deaths.
sentences.zh: 不知道确切什么时候会达到这个数字，但我们每天都在稳步攀升至那个死亡高峰。

sentences.en: I don't want to let that slide by.
sentences.zh: 我不想让这一点被忽略。

sentences.en: You're saying that it feels likely that the United States will hit 300,000 before the pandemic's over.
sentences.zh: 你是说，美国在疫情结束前很有可能会达到30万死亡病例。

sentences.en: Oh, before it's over?
sentences.zh: 哦，在结束之前？

sentences.en: Yeah, the question is when before it's over.
sentences.zh: 是的，问题是在结束前的什么时候。

sentences.en: I mean, it's not just me, it's the models.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，不仅仅是我，模型也是这么显示的。

sentences.en: Some models suggest that this is going to be, you know, well before Christmas.
sentences.zh: 一些模型表明，这将在，你知道，圣诞节前很久发生。

sentences.en: 300,000 American dead before Christmas would be absolutely horrific.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节前30万美国人死亡将是绝对可怕的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it would.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And we can avoid that by being smart, using masks, socially distancing, all the usual things.
sentences.zh: 我们可以通过明智行事、佩戴口罩、保持社交距离以及所有常规措施来避免这种情况。

sentences.en: But we have to do it.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须去做。

sentences.en: And of course, the fall in the U.S., beyond everything we're talking about, means something else, which is the flu.
sentences.zh: 当然，除了我们谈论的一切之外，美国的秋天还意味着另一件事，那就是流感。

sentences.en: The flu is now about to kind of merge with the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 流感现在即将与新冠病毒融合。

sentences.en: And I know that that has raised some fears.
sentences.zh: 我知道这引起了一些担忧。

sentences.en: Is that something you worry about?
sentences.zh: 这是你担心的事情吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: And I'm kind of an outlier on this, but there are doctors who agree with me.
sentences.zh: 在这方面我算是一个异类，但也有医生同意我的观点。

sentences.en: Flu doesn't sit around, hide in the country during the year.
sentences.zh: 流感不会在一年中一直潜伏在这个国家。

sentences.en: Flu travels.
sentences.zh: 流感会传播。

sentences.en: It migrates to the southern hemisphere and hits them in the middle of their winter.
sentences.zh: 它会迁徙到南半球，并在他们的冬季中期袭击他们。

sentences.en: And then it comes back in the fall.
sentences.zh: 然后它会在秋天回来。

sentences.en: But flu transmission went to zero in this country in the third week of April during lockdown.
sentences.zh: 但在封锁期间，也就是4月的第三周，这个国家的流感传播率降到了零。

sentences.en: It just went, boom, right down to zero.
sentences.zh: 它直接，砰的一声，降到了零。

sentences.en: And then it did not really go south.
sentences.zh: 然后它并没有真正向南传播。

sentences.en: Because people aren't really flying south.
sentences.zh: 因为人们并没有真正飞往南方。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It turns out that flu in Australia is down by 99% this year.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，今年澳大利亚的流感病例下降了99%。

sentences.en: And in the rest of the southern hemisphere, it's way, way, way down too.
sentences.zh: 在南半球的其他地区，流感病例也大幅下降。

sentences.en: You know, Chile, Argentina, New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 你知道，智利、阿根廷、新西兰。

sentences.en: If it isn't big there, and there are no flights from there to here, you can't reseed flu here.
sentences.zh: 如果那里没有大规模爆发，而且没有从那里飞往这里的航班，你就无法在这里重新播下流感的种子。

sentences.en: And also, practicing social distancing, as we are now, cuts down flu transmission in any year.
sentences.zh: 而且，像我们现在这样实行社交距离，在任何一年都能减少流感传播。

sentences.en: So I don't expect a big flu season.
sentences.zh: 所以我预计不会有大的流感季节。

sentences.en: But I still think everybody should get their flu shot, and I got mine, in case I'm wrong.
sentences.zh: 但我仍然认为每个人都应该接种流感疫苗，我也接种了，以防我错了。

sentences.en: So it sounds like another incentive to abide by all the rules around the coronavirus is that it is very nicely diminished flu.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来遵守所有关于新冠病毒的规定，还有一个额外的好处，那就是它非常有效地减少了流感。

sentences.en: Well, and other respiratory diseases, RSV, and the cold coronaviruses and things, any respiratory disease, they get knocked out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，还有其他呼吸道疾病，RSV，以及普通感冒冠状病毒等等，任何呼吸道疾病，它们都被消灭了。

sentences.en: All those diseases have dropped in this country.
sentences.zh: 所有这些疾病在这个国家都下降了。

sentences.en: But still, I'm hearing you say, in your role as our collective conscience, that everyone should still get the flu vaccine, just in case, in order to kind of take it off our plate.
sentences.zh: 但作为我们的集体良知，我还是听到你说，每个人都应该接种流感疫苗，以防万一，这样可以让我们少操一份心。

sentences.en: And here I should say, Donald, and I've always wanted to be your A student in this respect, I got the flu vaccine just a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 在这里我应该说，唐纳德，我一直想成为你在这一方面的好学生，我几天前刚接种了流感疫苗。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Excellent.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I got mine.
sentences.zh: 我也接种了。

sentences.en: I got the senior shot, the four times as powerful one that you can't get unless you're over 65.
sentences.zh: 我接种的是老年人疫苗，那种药效强四倍的疫苗，除非你超过65岁，否则无法接种。

sentences.en: I've had people ask me, how do I get one of those?
sentences.zh: 有人问我，我怎么才能弄到那种疫苗？

sentences.en: And I'm like, no, insurance will not pay for it until you're over 65.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，在65岁之前保险是不予支付的。

sentences.en: Unrest in the city of Kenosha, Wisconsin, turned violent on Monday night as protests over the police shooting of a black man there, Jacob Blake, gave way to fires, destruction,
